Vital that children have a stake in the future

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Elon Musk megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Sawyer Merritt (@SawyerMerritt); megjelent: 2026-11-26T22:21:15+00:00; link: https://x.com/SawyerMerritt/status/2126078859271369064; média: 2 kép]
Elon has announced that he will gift one @SpaceX share to each of the ~70 million children in America every year.

At SpaceX’s current share price, that amounts to over $9 billion in gifts annually. If SpaceX’s stock price goes up, the value of those gifts/shares will be worth a lot more.

This would be the largest gifting pledge in history.
